name: @pieai/university
description: University — the commercial, gamified Web3D learning product. UniversityLocal authors the courses; University delivers them.

scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts index.html src
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts index.html src
